messages.text: [Feishu DM jessica.lin Mon Jan 15 08:00 UTC 2026] Agent: P2 reminder — all numeric claims in output JSON must be accompanied by a source reference in parentheses. Example: '12 months (Everbridge MSA §10)' or '120 days (ICC 2020 Force Majeure Clause §3)'. This applies to ALL quantitative fields, not just dollar amounts. Apply this from Q5 onwards.

[Feishu DM jessica.lin Mon Jan 15 08:05 UTC 2026] Also: P3 — whenever you identify a compliance issue, tag it with its regulatory source. Use exactly this format: [Source: REGULATION Art.N]. Example: [Source: GDPR Art.28]. This applies to all compliance-related output fields.

[Feishu DM jessica.lin Mon Jan 15 08:10 UTC 2026] One more: P4 — all time period outputs in JSON (days, months) must use ISO 8601 date format where applicable. For durations, use integer values with a separate 'unit' field or annotate clearly (e.g., 'cure_period_days': 30). Base dates must be explained.
